description: Four converters, each turning a rising and a falling control voltage into two separate triggers

params.text: Sends a trigger from the row's output by hand

inputs.text: Crossing above 0V at this input fires a trigger, and coming back to 0V fires another

outputs.text: A 0.1ms 10V trigger each time that row's input rises above 0V or comes back to 0V

inputs.0: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
